items.title: The Microwave Incident
items.premise: Boss implements strict new rules about office lunch etiquette and cleanliness. Seconds later, he accidentally sets off the smoke alarm by reheating fish for fifteen minutes.

items.title: Reply All Disaster
items.premise: An Employee panics after accidentally hitting 'Reply All' on a company-wide email with a rant about the freezing office temperature. The panic turns to relief when the Boss replies all agreeing and offering hot cocoa.

items.title: The Wi-Fi Hostage
items.premise: Mom changes the household Wi-Fi password to the answer of 'What time did you clean your room?' Teen tries every possible lie as the password before actually doing the chore.

items.title: Dad's GPS Rivalry
items.premise: Dad refuses to follow the GPS voice instructions on a family road trip, insisting his shortcut is faster. The shortcut leads the family directly into a muddy cornfield while Grandma eats snacks in the back.

items.title: The Overthinker Date
items.premise: A guy spent two hours overanalyzing a cryptic text message from his date with his Best Friend. When he arrives at dinner, he discovers it was just a typo meant for her mom.

items.title: First Date Checklist
items.premise: A picky guy brings a literal scoring rubric to a first date to evaluate her compatibility. The girl takes the clipboard, scores him zero on social skills, and makes him pay for her meal.

items.title: Essay Word Count Padding
items.premise: A Student uses every fancy adjective and giant font trick to stretch a two-sentence thought into a five-page essay. Teacher returns it graded with a single giant 'Nice Try' red stamp.

items.title: Pop Quiz Poker Face
items.premise: A Student acts extremely confident during a surprise pop quiz to intimidate classmates into thinking it's easy. At the end, he hands in a paper with just his name and a cry for help.

items.title: The 90 Percent Off Trap
items.premise: Guy brags to his Smart Friend about saving hundreds of dollars during a mega clearance sale. Smart Friend points out he spent his entire rent budget on unneeded inflatable kayaks.

items.title: Forgotten Subscription Audit
items.premise: Guy investigates why his bank balance is zero despite eating instant noodles all week. He discovers he has been paying monthly fees for three gym memberships he never stepped foot in.

items.title: The Bus Stop Umbrella
items.premise: A guy willingly gets soaked in a downpour to share his small umbrella with a stranger at a bus stop. When he arrives late for a job interview, the stranger turns out to be the hiring manager.

items.title: Grandma's Secret Recipe
items.premise: A pushy Neighbor tries to sneakily copy Grandma's famous pie recipe while visiting. Grandma catches the Neighbor, laughs, and invites them into the kitchen to teach them step-by-step with love.
